Streets, residential areas, and commercial zones were inundated, with transportation severely disrupted.

Rescue teams evacuated residents from the most affected districts and warned about the risk of further water rise.

Meteorologists report that such extreme rainfall events are becoming increasingly frequent due to climate change.

warm

google exploits commitment

they're in pain

client came to me after $300k meta disaster

we just let results speak

blasting dopamine from "wins"

google addicts you to your profits

i wasted 2 years earning this
lost count of the stores i failed on meta

then built 7-figure brand on google alone

the industry worships zuck's playground
because it's easy to teach
hard to master

google? master it once
print forever

so stop being meta's bitch
become google's partner

your competitors are searching right now
ready to buy

will you intercept or chase FB likes?

only 1 correct answer…

choose wisely
